SET search_path TO "META_ADF", public;

SELECT t.target_id,
       t.ingest_pipeline_id, 
       t.ingest_type,
       t.src_type, 
	   t.src_db_nm, 
	   t.src_schema_nm, 
	   t.src_table_nm,
       t.landing_path,   
       t.extract_query
FROM   ctl_ingest_pipeline_run t
WHERE  master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
AND    t.src_db_nm  = '@{variables('v_src_db_name')}'
AND    status = 'PENDING'
ORDER  BY t.target_id;

SET search_path TO "META_ADF", public;

UPDATE ctl_ingest_pipeline_run t
SET start_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    status = 'RUNNING',
    attempt_no = COALESCE(attempt_no, 0) + 1,
    file_name = '@{concat(item().src_db_nm, '.', item().src_schema_nm, '.', item().src_table_nm, '.')}' 
                || to_char(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') 
                || '.parquet',
     update_by='ADF',
     update_dt=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE t.ingest_pipeline_id = '@{item().ingest_pipeline_id}' 
  AND t.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
RETURNING file_name;

SET search_path TO "META_ADF", public;

UPDATE ctl_ingest_pipeline_run t
SET ingest_pipeline_run_id = '',
    start_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    status = 'SUCCEEDED',
    extract_cnt=@{activity('Copy_data').output.rowsRead},
    save_cnt=@{activity('Copy_data').output.rowsCopied},
    file_size_mb=ROUND(@{activity('Copy_data').output.dataWritten}::numeric / 1048576.0, 1),
    end_dt=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
     update_by='ADF',
     update_dt=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE t.ingest_pipeline_id = '@{item().ingest_pipeline_id}' 
  AND t.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}' ;

SET search_path TO "META_ADF", public;

UPDATE ctl_ingest_pipeline_run t
SET ingest_pipeline_run_id = '',
    start_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    status = 'FAILED',
    attempt_no = COALESCE(attempt_no, 0) + 1,
    error_log = '@{replace(activity('Copy_Data').output.errors[0].Message, '''', '''''')}',
    end_dt=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
     update_by='ADF',
     update_dt=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE t.ingest_pipeline_id = '@{item().ingest_pipeline_id}' 
  AND t.master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}' ;

update
    "META".ctl_master_run_status
set
    child_total_cnt = 10,
    status = 'RUNNING',
    update_timestamp =  now()
where
    pipeline_nm = '@{pipeline().Pipeline}'
    and master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}' ;

INSERT INTO "META".ctl_ingest_run (
    master_run_id, 
    master_pipeline_name,
    ingest_pipeline_run_id, 
    target_id, 
    data_class, 
    load_type, 
    exec_group, 
    condition_type, 
    condition_frequency, 
    condition_interval, 
    incr_column_nm, 
    src_type, 
    src_db_nm, 
    src_schema_nm, 
    src_table_nm, 
    is_active, 
    pending_yn, 
    created_by, 
    created_dt, 
    update_by, 
    update_dt, 
    incr_column_hw_val, 
    incr_column_hw_type, 
    extract_query, 
    landing_path, 
    start_dt, 
    end_dt, 
    status, 
    save_cnt, 
    attempt_no, 
    error_log
)
SELECT
    '@{pipeline().RunId}' AS master_run_id,      
    '@{pipeline().Pipeline}' AS master_pipeline_name, 
    '-' AS ingest_pipeline_run_id ,    
    t.target_id,
    t.data_class,
    t.load_type,
    t.exec_group,
    t.condition_type,
    t.condition_frequency,
    t.condition_interval,
    t.incr_column_nm,
    t.src_type,
    t.src_db_nm,
    t.src_schema_nm,
    t.src_table_nm,
    t.is_active,
    t.pending_yn,
    'ADF_MASTER' AS created_by,
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS created_dt,
    NULL AS update_by,
    NULL AS update_dt,
    t.incr_column_hw_val,
    t.incr_column_hw_type,
    'SELECT * FROM ' || t.src_schema_nm || '.' || t.src_table_nm ||
    CASE
        WHEN t.load_type = 'incr' AND t.condition_frequency IS NOT NULL THEN
            ' WHERE ' ||
            CASE
                 WHEN t.condition_frequency IN ('minutely','hourly','daily','weekly','monthly','yearly') THEN
                     t.incr_column_nm || ' < ''' ||
                     CASE t.condition_frequency
                          WHEN 'minutely' THEN DATE_TRUNC('minute', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp || ''' and '|| t.incr_column_nm || ' >= ''' ||  DATE_TRUNC('minute', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp - (t.condition_interval || ' minutes')::interval ||  ''''
                          WHEN 'hourly'   THEN DATE_TRUNC('hour', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp || ''' and '|| t.incr_column_nm || ' >= ''' ||   DATE_TRUNC('hour', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp - (t.condition_interval || ' hours')::interval   || ''''
                          WHEN 'daily'    THEN DATE_TRUNC('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp || ''' and '|| t.incr_column_nm || ' >= '''|| CURRENT_DATE - (t.condition_interval || ' days')::interval       || ''''
                          WHEN 'weekly'   THEN DATE_TRUNC('day', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp || ''' and '|| t.incr_column_nm || ' >= '''|| CURRENT_DATE - (t.condition_interval*7 || ' days')::interval       || ''''
                          WHEN 'monthly'  THEN 
                               CASE WHEN t.incr_column_nm IN ('CLYM') THEN
                                         TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYMM') || ''' and '|| t.incr_column_nm || ' >= '''||  TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE - (t.condition_interval || ' months')::interval, 'YYMM')    || ''''
                                    ELSE DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp || ''' and '|| t.incr_column_nm || ' >= '''|| DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp  - (t.condition_interval || ' months')::interval       || ''''
                               END
                          WHEN 'yearly'   THEN DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp || ''' and '|| t.incr_column_nm || ' >= '''|| DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::timestamp - (t.condition_interval || ' years')::interval      || ''''
                     END
            END
        ELSE '' 
    END AS extract_query,
    'ingest/'||'@{pipeline().Pipeline}' AS landing_path,   -- ✅ 콤마 추가됨
    CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS start_dt,
    NULL AS end_dt,
    'READY' AS status,
    0 AS save_cnt,
    0 AS attempt_no,
    NULL AS error_log
FROM
    "META".ctl_ingest_target_master t
WHERE
    t.is_active = 'Y'
    AND    t.data_class = '@{variables('v_data_class')}'
AND    t.src_db_nm  = '@{variables('v_src_db_name')}'
-- (:p_exec_group 파라미터도 ADF 변수를 뜻하는 것이라면 아래와 같이 처리)
AND    ('@{variables('v_exec_group')}' = '' OR t.exec_group = '@{variables('v_exec_group')}')
AND    CASE
         WHEN '@{variables('v_run_mode')}' = 'PENDING'
              THEN (t.pending_yn = 'Y')                          -- 초기적재: load_type 무관
         ELSE (t.load_type = 'full' AND t.pending_yn = 'N')      -- 주기 full refresh: 정규 반복
       END

DO $$ 
DECLARE
    v_row_count INT;
    v_child_count INT; -- 추가된 변수: child 건수 저장용
BEGIN
    SET search_path TO "META_ADF", public;
    -- 1. 첫 번째 단일 INSERT 실행 (마스터 러닝 생성)
    INSERT INTO ctl_master_pipeline_run (
        master_run_id,
        master_pipeline_nm,
        trigger_id,
        trigger_nm,
        ingest_type,
        start_dt,
        exec_group, 
        created_by,
        status,
        skip_type,
        run_mode
    ) VALUES (
        '@{pipeline().RunId}',
        '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',                     
        '@{pipeline().TriggerId}',                         
        '@{pipeline().TriggerName}',                   
        'full', 
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,  
        '',
        'ADF',                           
        'PENDING',                                     
        null,
        CASE 
            WHEN '@{pipeline().TriggerType}' = 'Manual' THEN 'MANUAL' 
            ELSE 'SCHEDULE' 
        END                                             
    );

    -- 첫 번째 INSERT 실행 결과 확인
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_row_count = ROW_COUNT;

    -- 2. 첫 번째 INSERT가 성공(1건 이상 반영)했을 경우에만 다음 작업 수행
    IF v_row_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE NOTICE '첫 번째 INSERT 성공. %건 반영됨. 다음 작업을 진행합니다.', v_row_count;
        
        -- 3. INSERT ... SELECT 실행 (하위 인제스트 러닝 생성)
        INSERT INTO ctl_ingest_pipeline_run (
            ingest_pipeline_id,
            master_run_id,
            master_pipeline_nm,
            target_id,
            src_type,
            src_db_nm,
            src_schema_nm,
            src_table_nm,
            data_class,
            ingest_type,
            exec_group,
            condition_type,
            condition_frequency,
            condition_interval,
            incr_column_nm,
            incr_column_type,
            incr_column_hw_val,
            is_active,
            pending_yn,
            extract_query,
            landing_path,
            status,
            created_by,
            created_dt
        )
        SELECT
            gen_random_uuid()::text,
            '@{pipeline().RunId}',     
            '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',
            t.target_id,
            t.src_type,
            t.src_db_nm,
            t.src_schema_nm,
            t.src_table_nm,
            t.data_class,
            t.ingest_type,
            t.exec_group,
            t.condition_type,
            t.condition_frequency,
            t.condition_interval,
            t.incr_column_nm,
            t.incr_column_type,
            t.incr_column_hw_val,
            t.is_active,
            t.pending_yn,
            'select * from ' || t.src_schema_nm ||'.'||t.src_table_nm || ' fetch first 1 rows only with ur;',
            'ingest/'||'@{pipeline().Pipeline}',
            'PENDING',
            'ADF',
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP 
        FROM
            ctl_ingest_target_master t
        WHERE
            lower(t.is_active) = 'y'
            AND lower(t.data_class) = 'raw'
            AND CASE
                    WHEN lower('@{pipeline().parameters.P_IS_INIT_FULL}') = 'y'
                        THEN (lower(t.pending_yn) = 'y')
                    ELSE (lower(t.ingest_type) = 'full' AND lower(t.pending_yn) = 'n')
                END;

        -- 4. INSERT ... SELECT 건수 확인
        GET DIAGNOSTICS v_child_count = ROW_COUNT;

        -- 5. ctl_master_pipeline_run 의 child_total_cnt 업데이트
        UPDATE ctl_master_pipeline_run
           SET child_total_cnt = v_child_count ,
		       update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
			   update_by = 'ADF' 
         WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}';

        RAISE NOTICE 'INSERT ... SELECT 완료. child_total_cnt(%건) 업데이트 완료.', v_child_count;

    ELSE
        RAISE NOTICE '첫 번째 INSERT가 반영되지 않았습니다. 다음 작업을 건너뜁니다.';
    END IF;

EXCEPTION 
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE NOTICE '오류가 발생하여 모든 작업이 롤백되었습니다. 오류 메시지: %', SQLERRM;
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transaction failed: %', SQLERRM;
END $$;

DO $$ 
DECLARE
    v_row_count INT;
    v_child_count INT; -- 추가된 변수: child 건수 저장용
BEGIN
    SET search_path TO "META_ADF", public;
    -- 1. 첫 번째 단일 INSERT 실행 (마스터 러닝 생성)
    INSERT INTO ctl_master_pipeline_run (
        master_run_id,
        master_pipeline_nm,
        trigger_id,
        trigger_nm,
        ingest_type,
        start_dt,
        exec_group, 
        created_by,
        status,
        run_mode
    ) VALUES (
        '@{pipeline().RunId}',
        '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',                     
        '@{pipeline().TriggerId}',                         
        '@{pipeline().TriggerName}',                   
        CASE
                WHEN '@{pipeline().parameters.P_INIT_WAIT_YN}' = 'Y'
                  THEN 'FULL'
               ELSE '@{variables('v_ingest_type')}'
            END, 
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,  
        '',
        'ADF',                           
        'PENDING',                                     
        CASE 
            WHEN '@{pipeline().TriggerType}' = 'Manual' THEN 'MANUAL' 
            ELSE 'SCHEDULE' 
        END                                             
    );

    -- 첫 번째 INSERT 실행 결과 확인
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_row_count = ROW_COUNT;

    -- 2. 첫 번째 INSERT가 성공(1건 이상 반영)했을 경우에만 다음 작업 수행
    IF v_row_count > 0 THEN
        RAISE NOTICE '첫 번째 INSERT 성공. %건 반영됨. 다음 작업을 진행합니다.', v_row_count;
        
        -- 3. INSERT ... SELECT 실행 (하위 인제스트 러닝 생성)
        INSERT INTO ctl_ingest_pipeline_run (
            ingest_pipeline_id,
            master_run_id,
            master_pipeline_nm,
            target_id,
            src_type,
            src_db_nm,
            src_schema_nm,
            src_table_nm,
            data_class,
            ingest_type,
            exec_group,
            condition_type,
            condition_frequency,
            condition_interval,
            incr_column_nm,
            incr_column_type,
            incr_column_hw_val,
            incr_start_val,
            init_wait_yn,
            extract_query,
            landing_path,
            status,
            created_by,
            created_dt
        )
       SELECT
            gen_random_uuid()::text,
            '@{pipeline().RunId}',
            '@{pipeline().Pipeline}',
            t.target_id,
            t.src_type,
            t.src_db_nm,
            t.src_schema_nm,
            t.src_table_nm,
            t.data_class,
            CASE
                WHEN '@{pipeline().parameters.P_INIT_WAIT_YN}' = 'Y'
                  THEN 'FULL'
               ELSE t.ingest_type
            END,
            t.exec_group,
            t.condition_type,
            t.condition_frequency,
            t.condition_interval,
            t.incr_column_nm,
            t.incr_column_type,
            t.incr_column_hw_val,
            '@{variables('v_start_dt')}',
            t.init_wait_yn,
            CASE t.src_type
            ---------------- DB2 ----------------
            WHEN 'DB2' THEN
                format('select * from %s.%s where %s fetch first 1 rows only with ur ;',
                    t.src_schema_nm, t.src_table_nm,
                    CASE
                      WHEN t.init_wait_yn = 'Y' OR t.ingest_type = 'FULL' THEN '1=1'
                      WHEN t.ingest_type = 'INCR' THEN
                        t.incr_column_nm || ' >= ' ||
                        CASE t.incr_column_type
                          WHEN 'DATE'      THEN 'DATE('      || quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}') || ')'
                          WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN 'TIMESTAMP(' || quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}') || ')'
                          WHEN 'STRING'    THEN                quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}')
                        END
                    END)
            ---------------- MS-SQL ----------------
            WHEN 'MS-SQL' THEN
                format('SELECT * FROM [%s].[%s] WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE %s;',
                    t.src_schema_nm, t.src_table_nm,
                    CASE
                      WHEN t.init_wait_yn = 'Y' OR t.ingest_type = 'FULL' THEN '1=1'
                      WHEN t.ingest_type = 'INCR' THEN
                        '[' || t.incr_column_nm || '] >= ' ||
                        CASE t.incr_column_type
                          WHEN 'DATE'      THEN 'CAST(' || quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}') || ' AS DATE)'
                          WHEN 'TIMESTAMP' THEN 'CAST(' || quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}') || ' AS DATETIME2)'
                          WHEN 'STRING'    THEN            quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}')
                        END
                    END)
            ---------------- Azure COSMOS ----------------
            WHEN 'COSMOS' THEN
                CASE
                  WHEN t.init_wait_yn = 'Y' OR t.ingest_type = 'FULL'
                    THEN 'SELECT * FROM c'
                  WHEN t.ingest_type = 'INCR'
                    THEN format('SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.%s >= %s',
                           t.incr_column_nm,
                           quote_literal('@{variables('v_start_dt')}'))
              END
             else '-'
            END AS extract_query,
            '@{variables('v_landing_path')}',
            'PENDING',
            'ADF',
            CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        FROM ctl_ingest_target_master t
        WHERE t.delete_yn = 'N'
          AND t.data_class = '@{variables('v_data_class')}'
          AND CASE
                WHEN '@{pipeline().parameters.P_INIT_WAIT_YN}' = 'Y'
                  THEN (t.init_wait_yn = 'Y')
                ELSE (t.ingest_type = '@{variables('v_ingest_type')}' AND t.init_wait_yn = 'N')
              END;

        -- 4. INSERT ... SELECT 건수 확인
        GET DIAGNOSTICS v_child_count = ROW_COUNT;

        -- 5. ctl_master_pipeline_run 의 child_total_cnt 업데이트
        UPDATE ctl_master_pipeline_run
           SET child_total_cnt = v_child_count ,
		       update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
			   update_by = 'ADF' 
         WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}';

        RAISE NOTICE 'INSERT ... SELECT 완료. child_total_cnt(%건) 업데이트 완료.', v_child_count;

    ELSE
        RAISE NOTICE '첫 번째 INSERT가 반영되지 않았습니다. 다음 작업을 건너뜁니다.';
    END IF;

EXCEPTION 
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RAISE NOTICE '오류가 발생하여 모든 작업이 롤백되었습니다. 오류 메시지: %', SQLERRM;
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transaction failed: %', SQLERRM;
END $$;

SET search_path TO "META_ADF", public;

UPDATE "META_ADF".ctl_master_pipeline_run m
SET 
    child_succ_cnt = COALESCE(s.succ_cnt, 0),
    child_fail_cnt = COALESCE(s.fail_cnt, 0),
    -- 기존 child_total_cnt와 성공 건수가 같으면 SUCCESS, 실패 건수가 있으면 FAILED
    status = CASE 
                WHEN m.child_total_cnt = COALESCE(s.succ_cnt, 0) THEN 'SUCCEEDED'
                WHEN COALESCE(s.fail_cnt, 0) > 0 THEN 'FAILED'
                ELSE m.status
             END,
    -- 기존 child_total_cnt와 (성공+실패) 처리건수가 같으면 완료 시각 업데이트
    end_dt = CASE 
                WHEN m.child_total_cnt = (COALESCE(s.succ_cnt, 0) + COALESCE(s.fail_cnt, 0)) THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP 
                ELSE m.end_dt 
             END,
    update_by = 'ADF',
    update_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
FROM (
    SELECT 
        master_run_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'SUCCEEDED') AS succ_cnt,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'FAILED')  AS fail_cnt
    FROM ctl_ingest_pipeline_run
    WHERE master_run_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}'
    GROUP BY master_run_id
) s
WHERE m.master_run_id = s.master_run_id;
